reason: The cited code defines a monitor-creation tool that POSTs a body to a fixed Firecrawl API endpoint using an authenticated session and returns the API response as text, so it can return authenticated SaaS data such as the created monitor record. It does not show arbitrary host code execution. The parameters and description explicitly include email and webhookUrl and state that monitors can send configured email or webhook notifications, establishing an agent-configurable outbound delivery path. Although the monitor may later check public web targets, the cited lines show this tool returning the created monitor/API response, not scraped attacker-controlled web content into the agent context.
